metadata.common_names: Red sandalwood, saga seed tree, coral wood

data.habitat_ai: Lowland tropical rainforests (primary/secondary), gallery forests, coastal forests, swamp forests, deciduous forests at low elevations, disturbed areas, roadsides, dry open forest; often on forest margins.
data.ecological_function_ai: Nitrogen-fixing pioneer species for secondary succession and land reclamation; provides shade, green manure from leaf litter; wildlife forage (leaves for primates like langurs, seeds for birds/butterflies); soil improver; produces abundant litter.
data.native_adapted_habitats_ai: Tropical Asia (India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Thailand, Indochina, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, southern China) to northern Australasia (New Guinea, Solomon Islands, northern Australia - NT, Queensland).
data.agroforestry_use_cases_ai: Shade for coffee, cloves, rubber, nutmeg plantations; windbreaks/field borders; intercropped with spices, coconuts; green manure/nitrogen fixation; fuelwood/poles (thinned 3-5 years); fodder; land reclamation/re-forestation.
data.general_description_ai: Medium-large deciduous tree to 15-25m (max 40m) tall, bole to 0.6m diam, spreading crown often buttressed; bipinnate leaves to 40cm (2-6 pinna pairs, 8-21 elliptic-oblong leaflets 1.5-4.5x1-2cm); creamy-yellow fragrant flowers in 12-30cm racemes; curved woody pods 15-25x1.5-2cm splitting to reveal 8-12 scarlet lens-shaped seeds; hard reddish wood.
data.compatible_soil_types_ai: Deep well-drained to shallow rocky/clay/sandy/loamy; calcareous/neutral-slightly acidic (pH 4.5-7.5, pref 5-7); tolerates nutritionally poor, saline/salt spray.
data.growth_form_ai: Deciduous tree with spreading/rounded crown, erect bole (often buttressed/multiple-stemmed in age).
data.leaf_type_ai: Bipinnate compound (6-40cm long), 2-6 pairs pinnae each with 4-21 alternate elliptic-ovate leaflets (1.5-4.5x1-2.2cm), pale green, thin, glabrescent.
data.fruit_type_ai: Curved, dehiscent woody legume pod (15-25cm long x 1.3-2cm wide), brown-black, twisting open to expose 8-12(25) hard, shiny scarlet-red lens-shaped seeds (~0.8cm diam).
data.bark_characteristics_ai: Brown-grey to pinkish-brown, smooth to flaky/peeling.
data.stewardship_best_practices_ai: Full sun/light shade, moderate water, sheltered from high winds; drought tolerant once established; low maintenance; monitor crown for wind damage.
data.planting_recipes_ai: Scarify hard seeds (hot water 12-24h, nicking/scarification for 100% germination in 1-10 days); sow in situ/nursery polybags; spacing 1x2m windbreaks, 2x2m plantations (thin 3-5yrs), 5-10m shade; stem cuttings viable.
data.pruning_maintenance_ai: Coppice/pollard for fuel/fodder (resprouts well); thin plantations; prune to shape/reduce wind breakage in crown.
data.disease_pest_management_ai: Sapwood susceptible to drywood termites (heartwood resistant); sapstain fungi; few major pests/diseases reported; good air circulation/pruning prevents issues; seeds toxic raw.
data.fire_management_ai: Pioneer in disturbed areas; limited specific tolerance data; resprouts from coppice suggests moderate recovery potential.
data.cultural_significance_ai: Seeds as uniform-weight goldsmith measures/jewelry beads/love tokens (China: xiang si dou); children's games (Singapore: five-stones); red dye from bark/wood for tilak (India); traditional medicine (diarrhea, inflammation); ornamental/heritage tree; namesake (Malaysian Proton Saga car).
